faq.q: What does the package price include?
faq.a: Hotels, all transfers, the meals listed, and the sightseeing written into the package. Whether the air ticket is included is stated on each package card.

faq.q: Do I need a visa for Nepal or Thailand?
faq.a: Nepal grants a visa on arrival to Bangladeshi passport holders. The Thailand visa fee is around BDT 6,000 and is not included in the package. We help with the whole process.

By NPSB bank transfer, by card, mobile banking or EMI through SSLCommerz, or by bKash (bKash adds its charge). Your booking page shows the account details and the exact amount for each. Your invoice is emailed as soon as the payment clears.
Usually 12 to 20 travellers. Mustang Adventure runs as a group departure; the other packages can be taken privately or as a family on any date.
Cancel more than 21 days before departure and you are refunded everything except the non-refundable portion of the air ticket and hotels. The full policy comes with your invoice.
Yes. You can join a group departure on your own; a single room adds a {percent} supplement.

paras: Bhabaghure Holidays Aviation is a travel agency and tour operator working out of Agargaon, Dhaka. Group tours to Nepal and Thailand, domestic packages, air tickets, hotel bookings and visa support — all in one place.
Every group travels with our own Bangla-speaking operator, present from departure to return. What is and is not included is written down before you pay — there are no hidden charges.
Civil Aviation registration no. {licence}. We accept bank transfer, card, mobile banking and bKash, and email an invoice for every booking.
